description:
🚀 We've Built a Fully-Trustless Gateway Between Crypto and Banking 🌉

The next era of P2P onramp/offramp crypto transactions is here—at scale.
Make onchain contracts have real world financial consequences. Withdraw from smart contracts into real fiat. Make onchain prediction markets pay into your bank account directly.

What if we extended the utility of the Open Intent Framework to real-world banking networks by enlisting the help of informal participants? We’ve connected blockchain networks with real-world banking and payment networks, while revitalizing the sharing economy. Using zero-knowledge web proofs derived from Wise.com tracking URLs on SWIFT Bank Transfers, we’ve built a trustless infrastructure protocol—providing a secure, verifiable gateway for future onchain projects and smart contracts to interact with real world banking networks.

💰 Earn Real Yield, Not Meme Yields
No more farming useless GameFi tokens.
With our protocol, participating users earn sustainable yield by doing useful market making work to solve on-ramp and off-ramp intents—instead of gambling on volatile staking protocols.

👜 Your Wallet = Your Bank
Funds in your wallet can now work for you by solving real transactions and earning real fees.
Say goodbye to locking assets in risky third-party DEXs that are prime targets in the ongoing financial cyberwarfare.

🛡️ Security by Design
In today’s environment, it’s no longer if a protocol gets drained—but when.
Whether it’s:

👾 Hackers

🧑‍🌾 Yield Farmers

👨‍💻 Developers

📢 Influencers

All of them are potential threats to centralized liquidity.

Our model decentralizes liquidity across individual wallets, making it significantly harder to target.
You can’t exploit what you can’t locate. Most users stay anonymous, unless they flex on social media.

⚖️ Compliant & Clean
We’re OFAC-compliant:

🧼 Offchain Intents are scanned for blacklisted entities by attaching Zkproofs of Real-world identities (passport identification).

🪪 KYC is required

This isn’t just a protocol—it’s a paradigm shift in how crypto liquidity operates.
No more self-custodized wallets with unproductive funds sitting idle. No more traps. Just peer-to-peer power, reimagined.
how_its_made:
💼 QWallet
QWallet is an 🇺🇸 OFAC-compliant P2P on/off-ramp designed for secure and decentralized crypto-fiat transactions.

🧠 Identity & Verification
We integrate 🔐 Google Social Login with 🌐 ENS (Ethereum Name Service) to enable seamless onboarding and reputation tracking. Building on this, we leverage the Self Protocol, which utilizes Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) and redacted zero-knowledge proofs on NFC chips of ubiquitous ePassports, to enforce full regulatory compliance—ensuring every counterparty identity is screened against OFAC sanctions lists.

🚀 Intent-Based Order Flow
Built on Open Intents Framework, QWallet leverages the 🆕 EIP-7683 cross-chain standard to allow users and smart contracts to submit offramp orders as 📝 intents.

🤝 Solver-Based Fulfillment
Orders are fulfilled by 🧑‍💼 solvers, who:

✅ Have completed KYC verification

💰 Post a bond deposit when accepting offramp orders

⏱️ Must complete the transaction via 💸 Wise within a time limit

❌ Refunded most of their bond deposit if the transaction isn’t fulfilled in time
